scope: Exact algebraic relation, all 60 p47 labels and four known P-192 scalar controls; no unknown-target parity evaluator or CM speedup
statement: On the standard P-192 generator, the Lauter-Stange EDS normalization identity makes the absolute EDS-residue sign equal to a point-computable normalizer sign times the parity of the canonical unknown scalar; a known-scalar smooth endomorphism obeys the same universal propagation law and supplies no independent parity equation.
